run_copyright_check_all: run the copyright checker against all tracked files in the git repository HEAD
run_copyright_check_precommit: run the copyright checker in precommit mode to check only staged and modified files
run_copyright_check_list_output: run the copyright checker with list output mode to print only filenames without details
load_file_contents: use the load function to read and return the full text contents of a named file
log_copyright_status: use the log function to conditionally print why a file was skipped or is missing copyright
